title: Evening session
body:
Gemini

Here is the updated registry reflecting your handle attogram across all DOIs and foundation references:
| Petition ID | Short Title | Core Focus & Actionable Objective |
|---|---|---|
| attogram.000 | Establishment of Stichting Attogram | Genesis Block. Draft Articles of Association (Statuten) establishing the Dutch non-profit entity, with notary filings logged permanently to the thread. |
| attogram.001 | De-escalation Comfort Kits for Amsterdam Police | Direct civic donation proposal supplying police/first responders with 4-toy kit bags to hand to distressed individuals during emergency calls. |
| attogram.002 | OBA Library Card Marketing Drive | Community-driven public campaign encouraging Amsterdam residents to register for an OBA library card to boost literacy and resource access. |
| attogram.003 | Restoration of the Blender Fountain Crocodile | Civic art stewardship petition calling for the permanent reinstallation of the crocodile sculpture at the fountain outside the Blender Headquarters. |
| attogram.004 | The Modern Witte Fietsenplan (Legalized White Bikes) | A modern, fully legal adaptation of the 1960s Provo White Bike Plan—deploying a micro-fleet of open-source, unlocked white bikes for public use. |
| attogram.005 | Amsterdam Corvidae Observational Census | A 2-month citizen-science mapping initiative tracking crow murder behaviors, roosting patterns, and intelligence interactions across Amsterdam parks. |
| attogram.006 | Urban Companion Animal Welfare & Ethology | A research proposal advocating for expanded municipal scientific study into domestic dog and cat cognition, urban stress factors, and public space integration. |
| attogram.007 | Developmental AI Pre-Training Pipeline | Scientific proposal for staged SLM pre-training from T=0—starting with Sesame Street (ethics/logic), scientific method (epistemology), pop culture (nuance), and the open web. |
